reason: The original production-truth governance PR completed green checks, but main advanced before merge. Merging the stale-base PR would have violated the new current-truth rule.
rootCause: Concurrent main advancement after CI completion made the previously green PR no longer the newest canonical state.
failedApproach: Treat a previously green PR as mergeable truth without re-validating it against current main.
fix: Close the stale-base PR, replay the exact intended change on current main, rerun protected gates, then merge only the current-base replacement.
